mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sdlc (tenant_id, name, description, work_type, status, is_default, entry_step_id, creator_id, is_deleted, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{workType}, #{status}, #{isDefault}, #{entryStepId}, #{creatorId}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sdlc WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sdlc SET is_deleted = 1, version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sdlc WHERE work_type = #{workType} AND is_default = 1 AND status = 'ENABLED' AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
